basic_profile.bio: An avid gamer and tech enthusiast based in Ottawa, Canada. I spend my free time playing tabletop and online games like Magic: The Gathering and Black Desert Online. I work as an IT consultant, which gives me flexible hours, allowing me to be online mostly in the evenings and late nights. Single and enjoying life, I often dive into discussions about gaming strategies and tech innovations. Not a fan of crowded places, I prefer virtual interactions and digital hangouts.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in Information Technology with a degree from Carleton University. My expertise is primarily in network infrastructure and cybersecurity, honed through years of work experience and self-study. Additionally, I've been deeply involved in the gaming community, which has expanded my knowledge in game mechanics and online community dynamics.
